objectives.description: Use FTS5-sanitizer workaround for queries with periods/hyphens
Frame acceptance honestly (not overclaiming recovery of inaccessible content)

notes: Found (not fixed, out of scope) a second pre-existing literature-search.sh bug: load_fidelity_map() only recognizes the older index.json 'path: sources/...' schema, silently skipping newer doc_id/chunks_dir-schema entries (including Wijesekera's and the pre-existing Simpson entry from a prior task), causing get_fidelity()'s fail-open default (unverified_summary) to wrongly quarantine both documents from default search results. Reproduced identically on Simpson to confirm it predates this task. Workaround: --include-unverified flag, used throughout this phase's validation queries.
